tools.name: fuse_get_balance
tools.description: Returns the native FUSE balance for an address, or an ERC-20 token balance when `tokenAddress` is supplied.

address.description: EOA or contract address to query (0x-prefixed, EIP-55 or lowercase).

tokenAddress.description: Optional ERC-20 token address. Omit to fetch the native FUSE balance.

tools.name: fuse_get_transaction
tools.description: Fetches a transaction by hash. Returns null if the transaction is not found.

tools.name: fuse_get_receipt
tools.description: Fetches the receipt for a mined transaction (status, gasUsed, logs). Returns null if the transaction is pending or unknown.

tools.name: fuse_read_contract
tools.description: Calls a view/pure function on a Fuse contract. ABI is auto-fetched from the verified Fuse explorer when not supplied.

functionName.description: Name of the view/pure function to call.

args.description: Positional arguments for the function (defaults to []).

abi.description: Optional ABI override. If omitted, the verified ABI is fetched from the Fuse explorer.

tools.name: fuse_get_token_metadata
tools.description: Reads name, symbol, decimals, and totalSupply for an ERC-20 token deployed on Fuse.

tools.name: fuse_get_gas_price
tools.description: Returns the current Fuse network gas price (in wei and gwei) along with EIP-1559 fee suggestions when available.

tools.name: fuse_resolve_ens
tools.description: Resolves an ENS name to its EVM address. ENS is not deployed on Fuse — resolution requires `ENS_RPC_URL` to be configured (typically pointing at Ethereum mainnet). Plain hex addresses are passed through.

name.description: ENS name to resolve (e.g. `vitalik.eth`). Plain addresses are returned unchanged.

tools.name: fuse_get_account_abstraction_info
tools.description: Reads ERC-4337 state for a smart account on Fuse: deployment status, EntryPoint nonce, and the account's deposit balance at the EntryPoint. Paymaster eligibility is not evaluated in v0.1.

nonceKey.description: Optional 192-bit nonce key as a decimal or 0x-prefixed hex string (defaults to 0).

tools.name: fuse_list_wallet_tokens
tools.description: Lists all ERC-20 tokens held by a wallet on Fuse, enriched with Fusebox metadata (symbol, decimals, USD value). Powered by the Fusebox SDK BalancesModule.

walletAddress.description: Wallet address whose ERC-20 token portfolio should be listed.

tools.name: fuse_list_wallet_nfts
tools.description: Lists all NFTs (ERC-721 / ERC-1155 collectibles) owned by a wallet on Fuse. Powered by the Fusebox SDK BalancesModule.

walletAddress.description: Wallet address whose NFT holdings should be listed.

tools.name: fuse_get_staking_options
tools.description: Lists every staking option supported by Fuse — token, APR, TVL, expiry, and the matching unstake token. Powered by the Fusebox SDK StakingModule.

tools.name: fuse_get_staked_tokens
tools.description: Returns the active staking positions for a wallet — staked amount, USD value, earned rewards, and APR per position. Powered by the Fusebox SDK StakingModule.

walletAddress.description: Smart-wallet address whose active staking positions should be returned.

tools.name: fuse_get_token_price
tools.description: Returns the current USD price for an ERC-20 token tracked by Fusebox. Powered by the Fusebox SDK TradeModule.

tokenAddress.description: Address of the ERC-20 token whose USD price should be returned.

tools.name: fuse_get_token_price_change
tools.description: Returns the 24-hour percentage price change for an ERC-20 token tracked by Fusebox. Powered by the Fusebox SDK TradeModule.

tokenAddress.description: Address of the ERC-20 token whose 24-hour price change should be returned.

tools.name: fuse_get_token_price_history
tools.description: Returns OHLC / interval price stats for an ERC-20 token over a week, month, or year. Powered by the Fusebox SDK TradeModule.

tokenAddress.description: Address of the ERC-20 token to fetch price history for.

timeFrame.description: Granularity / range for the price series.

tools.name: fuse_list_supported_tokens
tools.description: Returns the catalogue of ERC-20 tokens tracked by Fusebox (tradable, indexed, priced). Powered by the Fusebox SDK TradeModule.

tools.name: fuse_get_trade_quote
tools.description: Quotes a token swap on Fuse — expected output amount, route, and price impact. Read-only: returns the quote without submitting a trade. Powered by the Fusebox SDK TradeModule.

inputToken.description: Address of the token being sold.

outputToken.description: Address of the token being bought.

amount.description: Amount, expressed as a decimal string in the token's base units (wei for 18-decimal tokens).

exactIn.description: When true (default), `amount` is the sell amount. When false, `amount` is the desired buy amount.

tools.name: fuse_get_user_operations
tools.description: Returns the ERC-4337 UserOperation history for a smart account on Fuse, indexed via the Fusebox GraphQL service. Powered by the Fusebox SDK GraphQLModule.

sender.description: Smart-account address (UserOperation `sender`) to fetch history for.

tools.name: fuse_notification_create_webhook
tools.description: Create a Fusebox Notification webhook for a project. Requires `FUSEBOX_SECRET_API_KEY` (Notification API endpoints authenticate with both apiKey and API-SECRET).

projectId.description: Fuse Console project ID that owns the webhook.

webhookUrl.description: HTTPS URL that Fusebox will POST event payloads to.

eventType.description: Event filter. `ERC721` also covers ERC1155 events. `ALL` subscribes to every event type.

tools.name: fuse_notification_get_webhook
tools.description: Retrieve details of a single Fusebox Notification webhook. Requires `FUSEBOX_SECRET_API_KEY`.

tools.name: fuse_notification_list_project_webhooks
tools.description: List every Fusebox Notification webhook configured for a given project. Requires `FUSEBOX_SECRET_API_KEY`.

projectId.description: Project ID whose webhooks should be listed.

tools.name: fuse_notification_update_webhook
tools.description: Update a Fusebox Notification webhook's URL or event type. Requires `FUSEBOX_SECRET_API_KEY`.

webhookId.description: ID of the webhook to update.

tools.name: fuse_notification_delete_webhook
tools.description: Permanently delete a Fusebox Notification webhook. Destructive — the webhook stops receiving events. Requires `FUSEBOX_SECRET_API_KEY`.

webhookId.description: ID of the webhook to delete.

tools.name: fuse_notification_add_addresses
tools.description: Add one or more EVM addresses to a webhook's listening scope. Requires `FUSEBOX_SECRET_API_KEY`.

webhookId.description: ID of the webhook to extend.

addresses.description: EVM addresses to start monitoring for this webhook.

tools.name: fuse_notification_remove_addresses
tools.description: Remove EVM addresses from a webhook's listening scope. Requires `FUSEBOX_SECRET_API_KEY`.

webhookId.description: ID of the webhook to modify.

tools.name: fuse_notification_list_addresses
tools.description: List every EVM address monitored by a given webhook. Requires `FUSEBOX_SECRET_API_KEY`.

webhookId.description: Webhook ID whose monitored addresses should be listed.

tools.name: fuse_smart_wallet_authenticate
tools.description: Exchange an EIP-191 signature for a JWT used as Bearer auth on Smart Wallet API calls (e.g. `fuse_smart_wallet_get_actions`). Signing happens client-side; this tool only submits the signed payload.

signature.description: EIP-191 signature produced by the EOA owner.

ownerAddress.description: EOA address that signed the hash (the smart wallet's owner).

tools.name: fuse_smart_wallet_get_actions
tools.description: List the paginated action history (transfers, contract calls) of an authenticated smart wallet. The JWT comes from `fuse_smart_wallet_authenticate`.

tokenAddress.description: Optional ERC-20 token address to filter actions by.

tools.name: fuse_trade_indicative_price
tools.description: Returns an indicative price + route for a swap on Fuse (0x-style response). One of `sellAmount` / `buyAmount` must be provided.

sellToken.description: ERC-20 contract address of the token to sell.

buyToken.description: ERC-20 contract address of the token to buy.

sellAmount.description: Sell amount in base units (mutually exclusive with `buyAmount`).

buyAmount.description: Desired buy amount in base units (mutually exclusive with `sellAmount`).

slippagePercentage.description: Max slippage as a decimal string (e.g. `0.01` = 1%).

tools.name: fuse_trade_liquidity_sources
tools.description: Returns the liquidity sources currently enabled for Fuse-chain trades (e.g. voltage.finance, sub-pools).

tools.name: fuse_trade_price_change_over_duration
tools.description: Returns a token's price change over a custom day-count window (`{ priceChange, currentPrice, previousPrice }`).

tokenAddress.description: ERC-20 contract address of the token.

days.description: Number of days to look back when computing the price change.

tools.name: fuse_explorer_query
tools.description: Generic dispatcher for the Fusebox Explorer API (`/api/v0/explorer/`). Pass `module` + `action` + any additional query params. Covers all 40+ etherscan-compatible endpoints including balances, logs, transactions, contract ABI/source, and the five contract-verify POST routes.

params.description: Additional query parameters (e.g. `address`, `fromBlock`, `toBlock`, `topic0`). Omit `module`, `action`, and `apiKey` — they're injected automatically.

method.description: HTTP method (default GET). Use POST only for the five `contract/verify*` actions, which also accept a JSON body.

body.description: JSON body for POST verify-* actions.

tools.name: fuse_get_signer_address
tools.description: Returns the EOA address controlled by the server's configured `FUSE_PRIVATE_KEY`. Use this before any write tool to confirm which account will pay gas and send transactions.

tools.name: fuse_send_native
tools.description: Submits a signed transaction transferring native FUSE from the server's signer to a recipient. Returns the transaction hash; use `fuse_get_receipt` to confirm inclusion.

amount.description: Amount of FUSE to send (default unit: FUSE — pass `unit: "wei"` for raw wei).

unit.description: `display` (default) treats `amount` as FUSE; `base` treats it as wei.

tools.name: fuse_send_erc20
tools.description: Submits a signed `ERC20.transfer(to, amount)` from the server's signer. Decimals are auto-fetched from the token; use `unit: "base"` to skip scaling.

amount.description: Amount to transfer. Default unit is the token's display unit (decimals auto-detected); pass `unit: "base"` to send raw base units.

tools.name: fuse_write_contract
tools.description: Signs and submits a state-mutating contract call from the server's signer. ABI is auto-fetched from the Fuse explorer when not supplied. Returns the transaction hash.

abi.description: Optional ABI override. If omitted, the verified ABI is fetched from the Fuse explorer.

valueWei.description: Native FUSE value to send with the call, in wei (for payable functions).

tools.name: fuse_deploy_contract
tools.description: Signs and submits a contract-deployment transaction using the server's signer. Returns the transaction hash, and the deployed contract address when `waitForReceipt: true`.

bytecode.description: Contract creation bytecode as a 0x-prefixed hex string.

abi.description: Contract ABI. Required so constructor arguments can be encoded correctly.

valueWei.description: Native FUSE to send with the deployment, in wei (payable constructors).

waitForReceipt.description: When true, the tool waits for the deployment to be mined and includes the deployed address in the response (default false).

tools.name: fuse_sign_message
tools.description: Signs a message with the server's signer using EIP-191 (`personal_sign`). Returns the 65-byte signature as hex. No on-chain transaction is submitted.

message.description: Message to sign. UTF-8 by default; pass `encoding: "hex"` for raw bytes (0x-prefixed).

tools.name: fuse_sign_typed_data
tools.description: Signs a structured EIP-712 payload with the server's signer. Returns the 65-byte signature as hex. No on-chain transaction is submitted.

types.description: EIP-712 types map (exclude the `EIP712Domain` entry — it's derived from `domain`).

primaryType.description: Name of the primary type to hash.

tools.name: fuse_smart_get_info
tools.description: Returns the ERC-4337 smart-wallet address derived from the configured signer, plus whether the Fuse paymaster (gasless mode) is enabled.

tools.name: fuse_smart_transfer_token
tools.description: Submits an ERC-4337 UserOperation transferring a token (native FUSE or ERC-20) from the configured smart wallet. Gasless when `FUSE_USE_PAYMASTER=true`.

tokenAddress.description: Token contract address. Use the native-token sentinel `0xeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee` for FUSE.

amount.description: Amount to transfer. Default unit is the token's display unit; pass `unit: "base"` for raw base units.

tools.name: fuse_smart_transfer_nft
tools.description: Submits an ERC-4337 UserOperation transferring an NFT (ERC-721 / ERC-1155) from the configured smart wallet to a recipient.

tokenId.description: NFT token ID (decimal or 0x-prefixed hex string).

tools.name: fuse_smart_approve_token
tools.description: Submits an ERC-4337 UserOperation calling `ERC20.approve(spender, amount)` from the configured smart wallet.

amount.description: Allowance amount. Default unit is the token's display unit; pass `unit: "base"` for raw base units. Use `"max"` to approve the uint256 maximum.

tools.name: fuse_smart_approve_nft
tools.description: Submits an ERC-4337 UserOperation calling `approve(spender, tokenId)` on an NFT contract from the configured smart wallet.

spender.description: Address being granted approval for the token ID.

tools.name: fuse_smart_approve_and_call
tools.description: Atomically approves a token and invokes a follow-up call on the spender from the configured smart wallet. Common DeFi pattern.

tokenAddress.description: ERC-20 token contract address to approve.

spender.description: Contract that will receive the subsequent call.

amount.description: Allowance amount in the token's display unit (or base if `unit: "base"`).

callData.description: Encoded calldata to invoke on `spender` after approval (0x-prefixed hex).

tools.name: fuse_smart_call_contract
tools.description: Submits an ERC-4337 UserOperation invoking arbitrary calldata on a contract from the configured smart wallet. Use when you need full control over the encoded call.

valueWei.description: Native FUSE to send with the call, in wei (default `0`).

tools.name: fuse_smart_execute_batch
tools.description: Submits a single ERC-4337 UserOperation that executes a sequence of contract calls atomically. Failed sub-calls revert the whole batch.

value.description: Native FUSE to send with the call, in wei (default `0`).

calls.description: Ordered list of contract calls to execute atomically as a single UserOp.

tools.name: fuse_smart_swap_tokens
tools.description: Submits an ERC-4337 UserOperation executing a swap on Fuse via the Fusebox trade engine. Quote a swap first with `fuse_get_trade_quote` to preview the route.

inputToken.description: Address of the token being sold.

outputToken.description: Address of the token being bought.

inputAmount.description: Amount in base units (wei for 18-decimal tokens).

exactIn.description: `true` (default) treats `inputAmount` as sell amount; `false` treats it as buy amount.

tools.name: fuse_smart_stake_token
tools.description: Submits an ERC-4337 UserOperation that stakes a token using Fuse's staking module. List options first with `fuse_get_staking_options`.

tokenAddress.description: Token to stake (must match a `fuse_get_staking_options` entry).

tokenAmount.description: Amount in base units (wei for 18-decimal tokens).

tools.name: fuse_smart_unstake_token
tools.description: Submits an ERC-4337 UserOperation that unstakes a token via Fuse's staking module.

tokenAmount.description: Amount to unstake, in base units.

unstakeTokenAddress.description: Receipt token address paired with the stake (`unStakeTokenAddress` from `fuse_get_staking_options`).
